scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @token-floor/server" "npm run dev -w @token-floor/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @token-floor/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @token-floor/adapter-claude && npm run build -w @token-floor/server && npm run build -w @token-floor/cli && npm run build -w @token-floor/web && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:cli: node scripts/prepare-cli-output.mjs && esbuild packages/cli/dist/index.js --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist --entry-names=cli --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --external:ws && node scripts/mark-cli-executable.mjs
